annotations.title: Explain a rating in plain words

description: Returns the Market Eyes Live MELANY rating for one U.S.-listed stock or ETF (every get_stock_rating field) with an explanation a first time investor can follow: what the tier word means, how to read the 0 to 100 composite, and for each of the eight factors its label, what it measures and what its score reads as (strong, leaning strong, middle, leaning weak or weak), on the label table for the asset class (a fund's quality slot is cost and structure, a REIT's valuation slot is price against funds from operations). Use this when the person wants the rating explained rather than just stated, for example 'explain the Market Eyes Live rating on MSFT' or 'what do these factor scores mean'. Do not use for quotes, options, crypto, non-U.S. listings, or a personal recommendation. Limitations: the daily-refreshed set answers instantly, other covered tickers are scored live at a lower hourly limit; the explanations describe the numbers and never say what to do; it does not return any trade plan values. Method: https://marketeyeslive.com/how-melany-is-tested.html. Research data, not financial advice; read-only, never places trades.

symbol.description: U.S. ticker symbol, e.g. NVDA, AAPL, VOO

name: explain_rating

outputSchema.description: The rating (every get_stock_rating field) plus explained. Omitted for not-covered, not-found or rate-limited results, which return an explanatory text message instead.

asset_class.description: stock, etf or reit: which label table the eight factor slots carry (a fund's quality slot is cost and structure, a REIT's valuation slot is price against funds from operations)

record.description: the public record for this tier in one sentence; null when the feed could not be read

score.description: how to read the composite (and, for a speculative rung, the separate score that sets it)

speculative_score.description: for Rising Star, Very Promising and Promising: the speculative model's own 0 to 100 score, which sets the rung (the composite is the main model's score); null otherwise or when not carried

freshness.description: present only when scored live on demand

methodology.description: how the ratings are built and graded

rating_page.description: the public rating page for this ticker

rating_tier.description: Conviction tier. Mature ladder, weakest to strongest: Unfavorable, Hold, Favorable, Highest Conviction. Favorable and Highest Conviction are both favorable reads; Highest Conviction is a composite of 69 or above (for a stock, a small hysteresis can hold a borderline label steady between refreshes; a fund or REIT word follows its label in the app, which has none). Names the mature ladder does not cover carry their own label: Promising, then Very Promising, then Rising Star for names without mature fundamentals, Runner! for a momentum surge, Catalyst Watch for a news-driven gap up on volume. ETFs and REITs use the same mature ladder, chosen by the tone of the fund's own label in the app (a favorable fund label reads Favorable or Highest Conviction, a cautious or neutral one Hold, a negative one Unfavorable); a leveraged or inverse fund never reads above Hold. These nine words are the complete set; null when no tier applies.

trade_plan.description: Present only when Market Eyes Live has a trade plan for this ticker (including a suggested entry zone and a model position size; the same plan for every reader, not based on anyone's account, holdings or finances). The plan values are never included here; they are part of a Market Eyes Live subscription.

described_on.description: the rating page, present when that page describes the plan

included.description: always false: the plan values are not part of this data
